```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import cv2


def main():
    default_result = {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }

    try:
        if len(sys.argv) < 2:
            print(json.dumps(default_result, ensure_ascii=False))
            return

        image_path = sys.argv[1]

        ocr_text = ""

        try:
            data = np.fromfile(image_path, dtype=np.uint8)
            img = cv2.imdecode(data, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        except Exception:
            print(json.dumps(default_result, ensure_ascii=False))
            return

        if img is None:
            print(json.dumps(default_result, ensure_ascii=False))
            return

        h, w = img.shape[:2]
        if h < 10 or w < 10:
            print(json.dumps(default_result, ensure_ascii=False))
            return

        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)

        # ================================================
        # OCR keyword analysis (priority 1)
        # ================================================
        ocr_upper = ocr_text.upper().strip() if ocr_text else ""

        arch_keywords = [
            "CNN", "TRANSFORMER", "ATTENTION", "ENCODER", "DECODER",
            "BLOCK", "EMBEDDING", "CLASSIFIER", "FEATURE EXTRACTOR",
            "ALEXNET", "RESNET", "VGG", "GOOGLENET",
            "CONVOLUTION", "POOLING", "DENSE", "LINEAR",
            "LAYER", "NEURAL NETWORK", "BACKBONE", "BOTTLENECK",
            "FEATURE MAP", "ACTIVATION", "RELU", "GELU",
            "MULTI-HEAD", "SELF-ATTENTION", "CROSS-ATTENTION"
        ]

        exp_keywords = [
            "ACCURACY", "LOSS", "EPOCH", "PRECISION", "RECALL", "F1",
            "TRAIN", "VALIDATION", "VAL", "TEST", "PERFORMANCE",
            "AUC", "ROC", "CONFUSION", "BENCHMARK",
            "MAP", "IOU", "MSE", "MAE", "FLOPS", "PARAMS",
            "FPS", "LATENCY", "TOP-1", "TOP-5", "ERROR RATE",
            "CURVE", "PLOT", "RESULT", "COMPARISON"
        ]

        dataset_keywords = [
            "DATASET", "SAMPLE", "CLASS", "CATEGORY",
            "TRAINING SET", "TEST SET", "VALIDATION SET",
            "EXAMPLE", "INPUT IMAGE", "GROUND TRUTH",
            "ANNOTATION", "LABEL", "DATA DISTRIBUTION"
        ]

        ocr_arch_count = sum(1 for kw in arch_keywords if kw in ocr_upper)
        ocr_exp_count = sum(1 for kw in exp_keywords if kw in ocr_upper)
        ocr_dataset_count = sum(1 for kw in dataset_keywords if kw in ocr_upper)

        # Extract component names from OCR
        component_map = [
            ("AlexNet", ["ALEXNET"]),
            ("ResNet", ["RESNET", "RES-NET"]),
            ("VGG", ["VGG", "VGG16", "VGG19"]),
            ("GoogLeNet", ["GOOGLENET", "GOOGLE NET", "INCEPTION"]),
            ("Transformer", ["TRANSFORMER"]),
            ("Transformer Encoder", ["TRANSFORMER ENCODER"]),
            ("Transformer Decoder", ["TRANSFORMER DECODER"]),
            ("CNN", ["CNN", "CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL"]),
            ("Attention Module", ["ATTENTION MODULE", "SELF-ATTENTION",
                                  "CROSS-ATTENTION", "MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION"]),
            ("Encoder", ["ENCODER"]),
            ("Decoder", ["DECODER"]),
            ("Embedding", ["EMBEDDING"]),
            ("Classifier", ["CLASSIFIER"]),
            ("Feature Extractor", ["FEATURE EXTRACTOR"]),
            ("LSTM", ["LSTM"]),
            ("GRU", ["GRU"]),
            ("BERT", ["BERT"]),
            ("ViT", ["VIT", "VISION TRANSFORMER"]),
            ("Accuracy", ["ACCURACY", "ACC"]),
            ("Precision", ["PRECISION"]),
            ("Recall", ["RECALL"]),
            ("F1-score", ["F1-SCORE", "F1 SCORE"]),
            ("Loss", ["LOSS", "CROSS-ENTROPY", "CROSS ENTROPY"]),
            ("mAP", ["MAP", "MEAN AVERAGE PRECISION"]),
            ("IoU", ["IOU", "INTERSECTION OVER UNION"]),
        ]

        components = []
        seen = set()
        for comp_name, comp_keywords in component_map:
            if any(kw in ocr_upper for kw in comp_keywords):
                if comp_name not in seen:
                    components.append(comp_name)
                    seen.add(comp_name)

        # ================================================
        # Visual analysis (priority 3)
        # ================================================

        # Background whiteness
        white_ratio = float(np.mean(gray > 220))

        # Color saturation
        saturation = hsv[:, :, 1]
        sat_mean = float(np.mean(saturation))
        sat_high_ratio = float(np.mean(saturation > 100))
        sat_med_ratio = float(np.mean(saturation > 50))

        # Local variance (texture analysis)
        gray_f = gray.astype(np.float64)
        local_mean = cv2.blur(gray_f, (11, 11))
        local_mean_sq = cv2.blur(gray_f * gray_f, (11, 11))
        local_var = local_mean_sq - local_mean * local_mean
        local_var = np.maximum(local_var, 0)

        flat_ratio = float(np.mean(local_var < 20))
        very_flat_ratio = float(np.mean(local_var < 5))

        # Gradient magnitude
        grad_x = cv2.Sobel(gray, cv2.CV_64F, 1, 0, ksize=3)
        grad_y = cv2.Sobel(gray, cv2.CV_64F, 0, 1, ksize=3)
        grad_mag = np.sqrt(grad_x * grad_x + grad_y * grad_y)
        mean_grad = float(np.mean(grad_mag))

        # Axis-like features: dark lines on light background
        dark_thresh = 100
        row_dark_frac = np.mean(gray < dark_thresh, axis=1)
        col_dark_frac = np.mean(gray < dark_thresh, axis=0)

        has_h_line = bool(np.sum(row_dark_frac > 0.5) > 0)
        has_v_line = bool(np.sum(col_dark_frac > 0.5) > 0)
        has_axes = has_h_line and has_v_line

        # Grid cell variance (dataset detection)
        grid_n = 4
        cell_h = max(1, h // grid_n)
        cell_w = max(1, w // grid_n)
        cell_vars = []
        for i in range(grid_n):
            for j in range(grid_n):
                cell = gray[i * cell_h:(i + 1) * cell_h,
                            j * cell_w:(j + 1) * cell_w]
                if cell.size > 0:
                    cell_vars.append(float(np.var(cell)))
        avg_cell_var = float(np.mean(cell_vars)) if cell_vars else 0.0

        # Color quantization diversity
        small = cv2.resize(img, (64, 64))
        quant_pixels = (small // 32) * 32
        unique_colors = int(len(np.unique(quant_pixels.reshape(-1, 3), axis=0)))

        # ================================================
        # Scoring
        # ================================================

        # OCR scoring (highest priority)
        score_exp = ocr_exp_count * 15
        score_arch = ocr_arch_count * 15
        score_dataset = ocr_dataset_count * 15

        # Visual scoring - Experiment result
        if has_axes:
            score_exp += 6
        if has_h_line or has_v_line:
            score_exp += 3
        if white_ratio > 0.1:
            score_exp += 1
        if 2 < mean_grad < 35:
            score_exp += 1

        # Visual scoring - Architecture
        if white_ratio > 0.15 and sat_med_ratio > 0.01:
            score_arch += 3
        if very_flat_ratio > 0.1:
            score_arch += 2
        if sat_high_ratio > 0.02:
            score_arch += 1
        if 3 < unique_colors < 30:
            score_arch += 1

        # Visual scoring - Dataset
        if avg_cell_var > 2000:
            score_dataset += 3
        if mean_grad > 10:
            score_dataset += 2
        if sat_mean > 40:
            score_dataset += 1
        if unique_colors > 15:
            score_dataset += 1
        if very_flat_ratio < 0.15:
            score_dataset += 1

        # ================================================
        # Classification (priority: exp > arch > dataset > other)
        # ================================================
        min_threshold = 2

        if score_exp >= min_threshold and score_exp >= score_arch and score_exp >= score_dataset:
            result = {
                "type": "experiment_result",
                "description": "展示实验结果图表，包含模型性能指标比较",
                "important_components": components[:5] if components else [],
                "code_relevant_information": "需要实现模型训练与评估流程，记录实验指标并进行可视化对比"
            }
        elif score_arch >= min_threshold and score_arch >= score_dataset:
            result = {
                "type": "architecture",
                "description": "展示模型网络结构和数据流关系",
                "important_components": components[:5] if components else [],
                "code_relevant_information": "需要实现对应的网络结构模块和前向传播计算逻辑"
            }
        elif score_dataset >= min_threshold:
            result = {
                "type": "dataset",
                "description": "展示数据集样本示例和类别展示",
                "important_components": [],
                "code_relevant_information": "需要实现数据加载、预处理和增强流程"
            }
        else:
            result = default_result

        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps(default_result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
